# Go architecture decoders

These are unmodified Go sources from the Go toolchain's vendored
`golang.org/x/arch` revision `v0.27.1-0.20260521044007-9c1a596a2c97`.
XT-Forge-SYS uses the x86 and arm64 decoder packages in process. Runtime Go
sources and their upstream LICENSE and PATENTS files are checked in for
offline builds.
